description: This file defines the Thread-Specific Data (TSD) layout and related functions for jemalloc, including data structures, macros, and inline functions for managing thread-local memory state.

methods.name: tsd_tsdn
methods.description: Converts a non-nullable tsd_t pointer to a nullable tsdn_t pointer.

methods.name: tsdn_null
methods.description: Checks if a tsdn_t pointer is NULL.

methods.name: tsdn_tsd
methods.description: Retrieves the tsd_t pointer from a tsdn_t.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_cleanup_register
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function for TSD.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_slow
methods.description: Fetches TSD data in slow path.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_impl
methods.description: Core function to fetch TSD, with options for initialization and minimal data.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_min
methods.description: Fetches a minimal TSD that requires no cleanup.

methods.name: tsd_internal_fetch
methods.description: Fetches TSD for internal background threads, using reincarnated state.

methods.name: tsd_nominal
methods.description: Checks if a TSD is in a nominal state.

methods.name: tsdn_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the tsdn_t for the current thread, or NULL if not available.

methods.name: tsd_rtree_ctx
methods.description: Gets the rtree context from a TSD.

methods.name: tsdn_rtree_ctx
methods.description: Gets the rtree context from a tsdn_t, with fallback.
